G1478.def:
**Ἑζεκίας** (Rec. Ἐζ-), -ου, ὁ (Heb. חִזְקִיָּה, _strength of Jehovah_),
**Hezekiah**, King of Judah: [[Mat.1.9, 10|Mat.1:9, 10]].†
(AS)

G1453.def:
**ἐγείρω**, [in LXX for קוּם, etc. ;] trans. (imperat. ἔγειρε used intransitively, [[Mat.9.5|Mat.9:5]], [[Mrk.2.11|Mrk.2:11]], al.);
1. **to awaken, arouse from sleep**: [[Mrk.4.38|Mrk.4:38]], [[Act.12.7|Act.12:7]]; metaphorically, of spiritual awakening, [[Rom.13.11|Rom.13:11]] (pass.), [[Eph.5.14|Eph.5:14]] pass., **to be aroused, wake up**: [[Mat.25.7|Mat.25:7]], [[Mrk.4.27|Mrk.4:27]]; ἀπὸ τ. ὕπνου, [[Mat.1.24|Mat.1:24]]
2. Freq. in NT, **to raise** from the dead: νεκρούς, [[Jhn.5.21|Jhn.5:21]], [[Act.26.8|Act.26:8]], [[2Co.1.9|2Co.1:9]]; ἐκ νεκρῶν, [[Jhn.12.1|Jhn.12:1]], [[Act.3.15|Act.3:15]], [[Rom.8.11|Rom.8:11]], al.; pass., **rise** from death: [[Mat.11.5|Mat.11:5]], [[Luk.7.22|Luk.7:22]], [[Jhn.2.22|Jhn.2:22]], [[Rom.6.9|Rom.6:9]], al.; ἀπὸ τ. νεκρῶν, [[Mat.14.2|Mat.14:2]], al.
3. In late Gk.,
(a) **to raise**, from sitting, lying, sickness; mid. and pass., **to rise**: [[Mat.9.5|Mat.9:5]], 7 [[Mrk.1.31; 9.27; 10.49|Mrk.1:31 9:27 10:49]], al.; redundant, like Heb. קוּם, [[Mat.2.15; 9.19|Mat.2:15 9:19]], [[Rev.11.1|Rev.11:1]] (see Dalman, 23f.);
(b) **to raise up, cause to appear**: [[Act.13.22|Act.13:22]] (cf. [[Jdg.2.18|Jdg.2:18]]); τέκνα, [[Mat.3.9|Mat.3:9]] pass., **to appear**: [[Mat.11.11|Mat.11:11]], [[Mrk.13.22|Mrk.13:22]], al.
4. **to rouse, stir up**; pass., **to rise** against: [[Mat.24.7|Mat.24:7]], [[Mrk.13.8|Mrk.13:8]].
5. Of buildings, **to raise**: τ. ναόν, [[Jhn.2.19, 20|Jhn.2:19, 20]] (cf . [[Deu.16.22|Deu.16:22]], [[Sir.49.13|Sir.49:13]]); (cf. δι-, ἐξ-, συν-εγείρω, and V. Cremer, 224).
(AS)

G1492.def:
**οἶδα**, (from same root as εἶδον, which see),
[in LXX chiefly for ידע ;] pf. with present meaning (plpf. as impf.; on irregular tense-forms, see App.),
**to have seen or perceived**, hence, **to know, have knowledge of**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.25.13|Mat.25:13]], [[Mrk.10.19|Mrk.10:19]], [[Jhn.10.4|Jhn.10:4]], [[Rom.7.7|Rom.7:7]], al.; with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.26.72|Mat.26:72]], [[Jhn.1.31|Jhn.1:31]], [[Act.3.16|Act.3:16]], al.; τ. θεόν, [[1Th.4.5|1Th.4:5]], [[Tit.1.16|Tit.1:16]], al.; with accusative and inf., [[Luk.4.41|Luk.4:41]], al.; before ὅτι, [[Mat.9.6|Mat.9:6]], [[Luk.20.21|Luk.20:21]], [[Jhn.3.2|Jhn.3:2]], [[Rom.2.2; 11.2|Rom.2:2 11:2]], al.; before quaest. indir., [[Mat.26.70|Mat.26:70]], [[Jhn.9.21|Jhn.9:21]], [[Eph.1.18|Eph.1:18]], al.; with inf., **to know how** (cl.), [[Mat.7.11|Mat.7:11]], [[Luk.11.13|Luk.11:13]], [[Php.4.12|Php.4:12]], [[1Th.4.4|1Th.4:4]], al.; in unique sense of **respect, appreciate**: [[1Th.5.12|1Th.5:12]] (but see also _ICC_ on [[1Th.4.4|1Th.4:4]]).
_SYN._: see: γινώσκω. (AS)

G1473.def:
**ἐγώ**, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς,
_of person(s) pron._
**I**.
(a) The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in [[Mat.3.11|Mat.3:11]], [[Mrk.1.8|Mrk.1:8]], [[Luk.3.16|Luk.3:16]], al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as [[Mat.10.16|Mat.10:16]], [[Jhn.10.17|Jhn.10:17]]; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. הִנֵּנִי, cf. [[1Ki.3.8|1Ki.3:8]]), [[Act.9.10|Act.9:10]]; ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), **I am**, [[Jhn.1.23|Jhn.1:23]] (LXX), [[Act.7.32|Act.7:32]] (LXX).
(b) The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, [[Jhn.14.20|Jhn.14:20]] μου τ. λόγους, [[Mat.7.24|Mat.7:24]] ὀπίσω μου, [[Mat.3.11|Mat.3:11]] ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, [[Rev.5.5|Rev.5:5]] also with the prep. πρός, as [[Mrk.9.19|Mrk.9:19]], al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι᾽ ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as [[Luk.10.16|Luk.10:16]], [[Jhn.7.23|Jhn.7:23]], [[Mrk.14.7|Mrk.14:7]], al.
(with) The genitive μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, [[Mat.2.6|Mat.2:6]] μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, [[Mrk.9.24|Mrk.9:24]]
(d) τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. מַה־לִי וָלָךְ, [[Jdg.11.12|Jdg.11:12]], al.), i.e. **what have we in common**: [[Mat.8.29|Mat.8:29]], [[Mrk.1.24; 5.7|Mrk.1:24, 5:7]], [[Luk.8.28|Luk.8:28]], [[Jhn.2.4|Jhn.2:4]]; τί γάρ μοι, [[1Co.5.2|1Co.5:2]]
(e) The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (see M, _Pr._, 86f., M, _Th._, 131f.).
(f) κἀγώ (= καὶ ἐγώ), **and I, even I, I also**: [[Mat.2.8|Mat.2:8]], [[Luk.2.48|Luk.2:48]], [[Jhn.6.56|Jhn.6:56]], [[Rom.3.7|Rom.3:7]], [[1Co.7.40|1Co.7:40]], al.; κἀγώ . . . καί, **both . . . and**, [[Jhn.7.28|Jhn.7:28]]
(AS)

G1435.def:
**δῶρον**, -ου, τό
(δίδωμι), [in LXX chiefly for קׇרְבָּן, also for מִנְחָה, etc. ;]
**a gift, present**: [[Mat.2.11|Mat.2:11]], [[Rev.11.10|Rev.11:10]]; of gifts and sacrifices to God, [[Mat.5.23-24; 8.4; 15.5; 23.18-19|Mat.5:23-24 8:4 15:5 23:18-19]], [[Mrk.7.11|Mrk.7:11]], [[Luk.21.1|Luk.21:1]], 4, [[Heb.5.1; 8.3-4; 9.9; 11.4|Heb.5:1 8:3-4 9:9 11:4]]; δ. θεοῦ, [[Eph.2.8|Eph.2:8]]†
_SYN._: see word δόμα (AS)

G1410.def:
**δύναμαι**, depon.,
[in LXX chiefly for יָכֹל ;]
**to be able, have power**, **whether by personal ability, permission, or opportunity**: with inf. (M, _Pr._, 205; WM, §44, 3) pres., [[Mat.6.24|Mat.6:24]], [[Mrk.2.7|Mrk.2:7]], [[Jhn.3.2|Jhn.3:2]], [[1Co.10.21|1Co.10:21]], al.; with inf. aor., [[Mat.3.9|Mat.3:9]], [[Mrk.1.45|Mrk.1:45]], [[Jhn.3.3|Jhn.3:3]], 4 [[Rom.8.39|Rom.8:39]], al.; with accusative, **to be able to do something**: [[Mrk.9.22|Mrk.9:22]], [[Luk.12.26|Luk.12:26]] [[2Co.13.8|2Co.13:8]]; absol., **to be able, capable, powerful**: [[1Co.3.2; 10.13|1Co.3:2 10:13]].
(AS)

G1487.def:
**εἰ**,
_conjunctive particle_, used in conditions and in indirect questions.
I. Conditional, **if**;
1. with indic, expressing a general assumption;
(a) pres.: before indic, pres., [[Mat.11.14|Mat.11:14]], [[Rom.8.25|Rom.8:25]], al.; before imperat., [[Mrk.4.23; 9.22|Mrk.4:23 9:22]], [[Jhn.15.18|Jhn.15:18]], [[1Co.7.9|1Co.7:9]], al.; before fut. indic., [[Luk.16.31|Luk.16:31]], [[Rom.8.11|Rom.8:11]], al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, [[Mat.12.26|Mat.12:26]], [[Rom.4.14|Rom.4:14]], al.; similarly, before impf., [[Luk.17.6|Luk.17:6]], [[Jhn.8.39|Jhn.8:39]]; before quæst., [[Mat.6.23|Mat.6:23]], [[Jhn.5.47; 7.23; 8.46|Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46]], [[1Pe.2.20|1Pe.2:20]];
(b) fut.: [[Mat.26.33|Mat.26:33]], [[1Pe.2.20|1Pe.2:20]];
(with) pf.: [[Jhn.11.12|Jhn.11:12]], [[Rom.6.5|Rom.6:5]], al.;
(d) aor.: [[Luk.16.11; 19.8|Luk.16:11 19:8]], [[Jhn.13.32; 18.23|Jhn.13:32, 18:23]], [[Rev.20.15|Rev.20:15]], al.
2. **Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί**: [[Mat.12.28|Mat.12:28]], [[Jhn.7.4|Jhn.7:4]], [[Rom.5.17|Rom.5:17]], al.
3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i).
4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: [[Mrk.15.44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1Jn.3.13|1Jn.3:13]], al.
5. C. indic., as in LXX ([[Num.14.3|Num.14:3]]o, [[1Sa.14.45|1Ki.14:45]], al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): [[Mrk.8.12|Mrk.8:12]], [[Heb.3.11|Heb.3:11]]" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX).
6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, **to express a merely possible condition**: [[Act.24.19; 27.39|Act.24:19 27:39]], [[1Co.14.10; 15.37|1Co.14:10 15:37]], I Pe3:14, 17.
II. Interrogative, **if, whether**.
1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., [[Mat.26.63|Mat.26:63]], [[Mrk.15.36|Mrk.15:36]], [[Act.19.2|Act.19:2]], [[2Co.13.5|2Co.13:5]], al.; fut., [[Mrk.3.2|Mrk.3:2]], [[Act.8.22|Act.8:22]], al.; aor., [[Mrk.15.44|Mrk.15:44]], [[1Co.1.16|1Co.1:16]], al.; with subjc. aor. (M, _Pr._, 194), [[Php.3.12|Php.3:12]]
2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, [[Gen.17.17|Gen.17:17]], al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), **in direct questions**: [[Mrk.8.23|Mrk.8:23]] (Tr., WH, txt.), [[Luk.13.23; 22.49|Luk.13:23, 22:49]], [[Act.19.2|Act.19:2]], al.
III. With other particles.
1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε.
2. εἰ δὲ καί, **but if also**: [[Luk.11.18|Luk.11:18]] **but even if**, [[1Co.4.7|1Co.4:7]], [[2Co.4.3; 11.16|2Co.4:3 11:16]].
3. εἰ δὲ μή, **but if not, but if otherwise**: [[Mrk.2.21, 22|Mrk.2:21, 22]] [[Jhn.14.2|Jhn.14:2]], [[Rev.2.5|Rev.2:5]], al.
4. εἰ καί, **if even, if also, although**: [[Mrk.14.29|Mrk.14:29]], [[Luk.11.8|Luk.11:8]], [[1Co.7.21|1Co.7:21]], [[2Co.4.16|2Co.4:16]], [[Php.2.17|Php.2:17]], al.
5. καὶ εἰ, **even if**, see: καί
6. εἰ μή, **if not, unless, except, but only**: [[Mat.24.22|Mat.24:22]], [[Mrk.2.26; 6.5|Mrk.2:26 6:5]], [[Jhn.9.33|Jhn.9:33]], [[1Co.7.17|1Co.7:17]] (**only**), [[Gal.1.19|Gal.1:19]] (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., _Ja._, xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), [[1Co.14.5; 15.2|1Co.14:5 15:2]], [[1Ti.5.19|1Ti.5:19]].
7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, _Pr._, 46), in oaths, **surely** ([[Ezk.33.27|Eze.33:27]], al.): [[Heb.6.14|Heb.6:14]].
8. εἴ πως, **if haply**: [[Act.27.12|Act.27:12]], [[Rom.1.10|Rom.1:10]].
9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, **whether . . . or**; [[Rom.12.6-8|Rom.12:6-8]], [[1Co.3.22; 13.8|1Co.3:22 13:8]], al.
(AS)

G1417.def:
**δύο**, _numeral_, indecl. exc. in dative, δυσί, δυσίν (Attic δυοῖν),
**two**: [[Mat.19.6|Mat.19:6]], [[Mrk.10.8|Mrk.10:8]], [[Jhn.2.6|Jhn.2:6]], al.; with pl. noun, [[Mat.9.27; 10.10|Mat.9:27 10:10]], al.; οἱ, τῶν, τοὺς δ., [[Mat.19.5; 20.24|Mat.19:5 20:24]], [[Mrk.10.8|Mrk.10:8]], [[Eph.2.15|Eph.2:15]], al.; δ. ἐξ, [[Luk.24.13|Luk.24:13]] distrib., ἀνὰ, κατὰ δ., **two and two, two apiece**: [[Luk.10.1|Luk.10:1]] (WH, ἀνὰ δ. [δύο]), [[Jhn.2.6|Jhn.2:6]], [[1Co.14.27|1Co.14:27]]; δύο δύο (= ἀνὰ δ., as LXX, [[Gen.6.19|Gen.6:19]] for שְׁנַיִם שְׁנַיִם, but not merely "Hebraism," cf. μυρία μυρία, Æsch., _Pers._, 981, and for usage in π. and MGr., see M, _Pr._, 21, 97), [[Mrk.6.7|Mrk.6:7]] εἰς δ. (**two and two**, Xen., _Cyr._, 7, 5, 17), **into two parts**, [[Mat.27.51|Mat.27:51]], [[Mrk.15.38|Mrk.15:38]].
(AS)

G1482.def:
**ἐθνικός**, -ή, -όν, [in Al.: [[Lev.21.7|Lev.21:7]] * ;]
1. **national** (Polyb.).
2. **foreign** (gramm.); in NT, as subst., ὁ ἐ., **the Gentile **(the adj. "describes character rather than mere position"; cf. ἔθνος, and see Cremer, 228): [[Mat.5.47; 6.7; 18.17|Mat.5:47 6:7 18:17]], [[3Jn.7|3Jo.7]].
† (AS)

G1424.def:
**δυσμή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(= δύσις, δύνω), [in LXX for בּוֹא, עֲרָבָה, etc. ;]
mostly in pl., opposite to ἀνατολαί;
1. **a setting**, as of the sun (accusative to Thayer, see word, so perhaps in [[Luk.12.54|Luk.12:54]]).
2. **the quarter of sunset, the west**: anarth., [[Mat.8.11; 24.27|Mat.8:11 24:27]], [[Luk.12.54; 13.29|Luk.12:54 13:29]], [[Rev.21.13|Rev.21:13]].†
(AS)

G1427.def:
**δώδεκα**, οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl.
**numeral, twelve**: [[Mat.9.20; 10.1|Mat.9:20 10:1]], al.; οἱ δ., _the apostles_, [[Mat.10.5|Mat.10:5]], [[Mrk.4.10|Mrk.4:10]], al.; in [[Act.19.7; 24.11|Act.19:7 24:11]], for Rec. δεκαδύο.
(AS)

G1432.def:
**δωρεάν**, see: δωρεά.
**δωρεά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
(δίδωμι), [in LXX chiefly (-άν) for חִנָּם, as [[Gen.29.15|Gen.29:15]] ;]
**a gift**: [[Act.11.17|Act.11:17]], [[Rom.5.15|Rom.5:15]], [[Heb.6.4|Heb.6:4]]; δ. τ. θεοῦ, [[Jhn.4.10|Jhn.4:10]], [[Act.8.20|Act.8:20]]; τ. Χριστοῦ, [[Eph.4.7|Eph.4:7]] τ. πνεύματος, [[Act.2.38; 10.45|Act.2:38 10:45]]; τ. δικαιοσύνης, [[Rom.5.17|Rom.5:17]] τ. χάριτος, [[Eph.3.7|Eph.3:7]] ἀνεκδιηγήτὶῳ δ., [[2Co.9.15|2Co.9:15]] Acc, δωρεάν, adverbially (as frequently in LXX),
(a) **freely**, **as a gift**: [[Mat.10.8|Mat.10:8]], [[Rom.3.24|Rom.3:24]], [[2Co.11.7|2Co.11:7]], [[2Th.3.8|2Th.3:8]], [[Rev.21.6; 22.17|Rev.21:6 22:17]];
(b) **in vain, uselessly**: ([[Jhn.15.25|Jhn.15:25]] LXX) [[Gal.2.21|Gal.2:21]]†
_SYN._: see: δόμα (AS)

G1430.def:
**δῶμα**, -τος, τό
(δέμω, _to build_), [in LXX for גָּג ;]
chiefly in poets and late (not Attic) prose;
1. **a house, hall**.
2. In LXX (and Hom., _Od._, x, 554; cf. MGr., _terrace_), **house-top**: ἐπὶ τ. δῶμα, [[Luk.5.19|Luk.5:19]], [[Act.10.9|Act.10:9]]; ἐπὶ τ. δώματος, -άτων, [[Mat.10.27; 24.17|Mat.10:27 24:17]], [[Mrk.13.15|Mrk.13:15]], [[Luk.12.3; 17.31|Luk.12:3 17:31]].†
(AS)

G1470.def:
**ἐγ-κρύπτω**,
[in LXX for טמן, etc. ;]
**to conceal in**: with accusative, before εἰς, [[Mat.13.33|Mat.13:33]]†
(AS)

G1441.def:
**ἑβδομηκοντάκις**, _adv._,
[in LXX for שִׁבְעִים, [[Gen.4.24|Gen.4:24]] * ;]
**seventy times**: ἑ. ἑπτά, **seventy times seven**, [[Mat.18.22|Mat.18:22]] (R, txt., _ICC_, in l.), or **seventy-seven times** (R, mg.; cf. M, _Pr._, 98; WM, 314; Meyer, in l.).†
(AS)

G1419.def:
**δυσ-βάστακτος**, -ον
(βαστάζω), [in LXX for נֵטֶל, [[Pro.27.3|Pro.27:3]] * ;]
**hard to be borne**: [[Mat.23.4|Mat.23:4]] (om. WH, txt., R, mg.), [[Luk.11.46|Luk.11:46]]†
(AS)

G1451.def:
**ἐγγύς**, _adv._,
[in LXX chiefly for קָרוֹב ;]
**near**;
1. **of place**: [[Jhn.19.20, 42|Jhn.19:20, 42]]; as prep. with genitive (M, _Pr._, 99), [[Luk.19.11|Luk.19:11]], [[Jhn.3.23; 6.19, 23; 11.18, 54|Jhn.3:23 6:19, 23 11:18, 54]], [[Act.1.12|Act.1:12]]; with dative, [[Act.9.38; 27.8|Act.9:38 27:8]]; superl., ἔγγιστα, [[Mrk.6.36|Mrk.6:36]], WH, mg.; metaphorically, ֹοἱ ἐ., opposite to οἱ μακράν, [[Eph.2.17|Eph.2:17]] ἐ. γίνεσθαι, [[Eph.2.13|Eph.2:13]] ἐ. σου τὸ ῥῆμα, [[Rom.10.8|Rom.10:8]] (LXX).
2. **Of time**: [[Mat.24.32; 26.18|Mat.24:32 26:18]], [[Mrk.13.28, 29|Mrk.13:28, 29]] [[Luk.21.30, 31|Luk.21:30, 31]] [[Jhn.2.13; 6.4; 7.2; 11.55|Jhn.2:13 6:4 7:2 11:55]], [[Rev.1.3; 22.10|Rev.1:3 22:10]]; ὁ κύριος ἐ., [[Php.4.5|Php.4:5]] before ἐπὶ θύραις, [[Mat.24.33|Mat.24:33]] compar., ἐγγύτερον (neut. of adj. -ος, used adverbially), [[Rom.13.11|Rom.13:11]] (cf. R, txt.); as prep. with genitive, ἐ. κατάρας, [[Heb.6.8|Heb.6:8]] ἀφανισμοῦ, [[Heb.8.13|Heb.8:13]] (cf. Cremer, 223).
† (AS)

G1439.def:
**ἐάω**, -ῶ,
[in LXX for רפה hi., etc. ;]
1. **to let, permit**: with accusative, with inf., with accusative and inf. (M, _Pr._, 205): [[Mat.24.43|Mat.24:43]], [[Luk.4.41; 22.51|Luk.4:41 22:51]], [[Act.14.16; 16.7, 19:30 23.32 27:32 28:4|Act.14.16; 16.7, 19:30 23.32 27:32 28:4]] , [[1Co.10.13|1Co.10:13]].
2. **to let alone, leave**: ἀγκύρας, [[Act.27.40|Act.27:40]] (cf. προσ-εάω).
† (AS)

G1486.def:
**ἔθω**, pf. with present sense εἴωθα,
[in LXX: [[Num.24.1|Num.24:1]] (כְּפַעַם־בְּפַעַם), Dan LXX Su 13, [[Sir.37.14|Sir.37:14]], [[4Ma.1.12|4Ma.1:12]] * ;]
**to be accustomed, wont**: [[Mat.27.15|Mat.27:15]], [[Mrk.10.1|Mrk.10:1]]; ptcp., τὸ εἰθός, **custom**: κατὰ τὸ εἰ. (Nu, l.with), [[Luk.4.16|Luk.4:16]], [[Act.17.2|Act.17:2]].†
(AS)

G1459.def:
**ἐγκαταλείπω**,
[in LXX chiefly for עזב ;]
1. **to leave behind**: ἡμῖν σπέρμα, [[Rom.9.29|Rom.9:29]] (LXX).
2. **to abandon, desert, forsake**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.27.46|Mat.27:46]] (LXX), [[Mrk.15.34|Mrk.15:34]] (ib.), [[Act.2.27|Act.2:27]] (LXX) (WH, ἐνκ-), [[2Ti.4.10, 16|2Ti.4:10, 16]] [[Heb.13.5|Heb.13:5]]" (LXX) ; τ. ἐπισυναγωγήν (cf. MM, _Exp._, xi), [[Heb.10.25|Heb.10:25]] Pass., [[Act.2.31|Act.2:31]] (WH, ἐνκ-), [[2Co.4.9|2Co.4:9]]
† (AS)

G1454.def:
**ἔγερσις**, -εως, ἡ (ἐγείρω, -ομαι)),
[in LXX: [[Jdg.7.19|Jdg.7:19]], Psa.138 (139)2 (קוּם), I [[Est.5.62|Est.5:62]] * ;]
1. **a rousing** (Plat.).
2. **a rising** (Ps, l.with): from death, [[Mat.27.53|Mat.27:53]]
† (AS)

G1416.def:
**δύνω ** Ion, and trag. form of δύω,
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
**to enter, sink into**; of the sun (sc. όντον), **set**: [[Mrk.1.32|Mrk.1:32]], [[Luk.4.40|Luk.4:40]]
(cf. ἐκ-, ἀπ-εκ-, ἐν-, ἐπ-εν-, παρ-εισ-, ἐπι-δύνω).†
δύω, see: δύνω
**δύνω ** Ion, and trag. form of δύω,
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
**to enter, sink into**; of the sun (sc. όντον), **set**: [[Mrk.1.32|Mrk.1:32]], [[Luk.4.40|Luk.4:40]]
(cf. ἐκ-, ἀπ-εκ-, ἐν-, ἐπ-εν-, παρ-εισ-, ἐπι-δύνω).†
δύω, see: δύνω
(AS)

G1407.def:
**δρέπανον**, -ου, τό
(later form of Attic δρεπάνη, δρέπω, _to pluck_), [in LXX for מַזְמֵדָה, חֶרְמֵשׁ, etc. ;]
**a sickle, pruning-hook**; [[Mrk.4.29|Mrk.4:29]], [[Rev.14.14-19|Rev.14:14-19]].†
(AS)

G1422.def:
**δύσκολος**, -ον
(κόλον, food), [in LXX for אֵיד, [[Jer.29.9|Jer.29:9]] ([[Jer.49.8|Jer.49:8]]) (of. δυσκολία, [[Job.34.30|Job.34:30]] εὔκολος, [[2Sa.15.3|2Ki.15:3]]) * ;]
1. properly, of persons, **hard to satisfy with food**, hence, generally, **hard to please** (Eur., Plat.).
2. Of things, **difficult, hard** (Arist.): [[Mrk.10.24|Mrk.10:24]]†
(AS)

G1413.def:
**δυνάστης**, -ου, ὁ
(δύναμαι), [in LXX for גִּבּוֹר, עָרִיץ, בַּיִת, etc. ;]
**a prince, ruler, potentate**: [[Luk.1.52|Luk.1:52]] of God ([[Sir.46.5, 16|Sir.46:5, 16]], [[2Ma.15.3|2Ma.15:3]]), [[1Ti.6.15|1Ti.6:15]]; of a high official (cf. δυνάσται Φαραώ, [[Gen.50.4|Gen.50:4]]), [[Act.8.27|Act.8:27]] (Cremer, 221).†
(AS)

G1471.def:
**ἔγκυος**, see: ἐνκ-.
ἔνκυoς (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν), -ον
(κύω, to conceive), [in LXX: [[Sir.42.10|Sir.42:10]] * ;]
**pregnant, big with child **: [[Luk.2.5|Luk.2:5]]†
(AS)

G1480.def:
**ἐθίζω**,
[in LXX: [[Sir.23.9, 13|Sir.23:9, 13]] [[2Ma.14.30|2Ma.14:30]] ;]
**to accustom**: pass. pf. ptcp., τὸ εἰθισμένον, **the established custom**, [[Luk.2.27|Luk.2:27]]†
(AS)

G1491.def:
**εἶδος**, -ους, τό,
[in LXX for מַרְאֶה,, etc. ;]
1. **that which is seen, appearance, external form**: [[Luk.3.22; 9.29|Luk.3:22 9:29]], [[Jhn.5.37|Jhn.5:37]], [[2Co.5.7|2Co.5:7]] (_ICC_ in l.).
2. **form, sort, kind**: [[1Th.5.22|1Th.5:22]]
† (AS)

G1436.def:
**ἔα**,
_interj._,
expressing surprise, indignation, fear (in cl. chiefly in poët.), **ah! ha!**: [[Luk.4.34|Luk.4:34]]†
(AS)

G1403.def:
**δοχή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(δέχομαι), [in LXX: [[Gen.21.8|Gen.21:8]], [[Est.1.3|Est.1:3]], al. (מִשְׁתֶּה), Dan LXX 5:1 (לֶחֶם) ;]
**a feast, banquet**: [[Luk.5.29; 14.13|Luk.5:29 14:13]].†
(AS)

G1449.def:
1. **to mark in ** or **on, to paint on **, (Herdotus Historicus)
2. **to inscribe, write in ** or **on **, (Herdotus Historicus):—;Pass., ἐγγεγραμμένος τι **having ** something **written on ** it, (Sophocles Tragicus); so Virgil **flores inscripti nomina. **
3. **to enter in the public register **, ἐγγρ. τὸν υἱὸν εἰς ἄνδρας (Demosthenes Orator):—;Pass., εἰς τοὺς δημότας ἐγγραφῆναι (Demosthenes Orator)
4. **to enter on the judge's list, to indict **, (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)

G1406.def:
**δραχμή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(δράσσομαι), [in LXX: in Hex. for in בֶּקַע, שֶׁקֶל Ezra for אֲדַרְכֹּן, דַּרְכְּמוֹן ;]
**a drachma**, **nearly equal to the Roman denarius **(see: δηνόριον): [[Luk.15.8-9|Luk.15:8-9]] (_DCG_, ii, 200).†
(AS)

G1474.def:
**ἐδαφίζω** (ἔδαφος)
[in LXX chiefly for רטשׁ pu. ;]
1. **to beat level like a threshing floor** (Theophr.).
2. **to dash to the ground** (Field, _Notes_, 74): [[Luk.19.44|Luk.19:44]] (cf. Psa.136(137):9, [[Hos.14.1|Hos.14:1]]).
† (AS)

G1455.def:
**ἐνκάθετος** (Rec. ἐγκ-), -αν
(ἐγκαθίημι), [in LXX: [[Job.31.9|Job.31:9]] (אָרַב), [[Job.19.12|Job.19:12]] * ;]
**suborned to lie in wait, lying in wait**: as subst., [[Luk.20.20|Luk.20:20]]†
(AS)

G1431.def:
**δωρεά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
(δίδωμι), [in LXX chiefly (-άν) for חִנָּם, as [[Gen.29.15|Gen.29:15]] ;]
**a gift**: [[Act.11.17|Act.11:17]], [[Rom.5.15|Rom.5:15]], [[Heb.6.4|Heb.6:4]]; δ. τ. θεοῦ, [[Jhn.4.10|Jhn.4:10]], [[Act.8.20|Act.8:20]]; τ. Χριστοῦ, [[Eph.4.7|Eph.4:7]] τ. πνεύματος, [[Act.2.38; 10.45|Act.2:38 10:45]]; τ. δικαιοσύνης, [[Rom.5.17|Rom.5:17]] τ. χάριτος, [[Eph.3.7|Eph.3:7]] ἀνεκδιηγήτὶῳ δ., [[2Co.9.15|2Co.9:15]] Acc, δωρεάν, adverbially (as frequently in LXX),
(a) **freely**, **as a gift**: [[Mat.10.8|Mat.10:8]], [[Rom.3.24|Rom.3:24]], [[2Co.11.7|2Co.11:7]], [[2Th.3.8|2Th.3:8]], [[Rev.21.6; 22.17|Rev.21:6 22:17]];
(b) **in vain, uselessly**: ([[Jhn.15.25|Jhn.15:25]] LXX) [[Gal.2.21|Gal.2:21]]†
_SYN._: see: δόμα (AS)

G1456.def:
**ἐγκαίνια**, see: ἐνκ-
**ἐνκαίνια** (Rec. ἐγκ-), -ων, τά (ἐν, καινός),
[in LXX for HSjrj, II [[Est.6.16, 17|Est.6:16, 17]], [[Neh.12.27|Neh.12:27]], [[Dan.3.2|Da TH 3:2]] (and cf. ἐγκαινισμός, [[Num.7.10|Num.7:10]], al., -ισις, [[Num.7.88|Num.7:88]]) *;]
dedication (anniversary of the cleansing of the Temple from the defilements of Antiochus Epiphanes) : [[Jhn.10.22|Jhn.10:22]]†
(AS)

G1445.def:
**Ἑβραῖος** (WH, Ἐβ-), -α, -ον (Aram, עִבְרַי), as subst., ὁ Ἑ.,
[in LXX for עֵבֶר, עִבְרִי ;]
**a Hebrew**.
1. In OT, of Israelites in contrast with those of another race ([[Gen.14.13|Gen.14:13]], [[Exo.1.15|Exo.1:15]], [[Deu.15.12|Deu.15:12]], al.).
2. In NT as the correlative of Ἑλληνιστής, a Jew who had adopted, in greater or less degree, Greek culture and Greek language. The distinction was not merely linguistic (_DB_, ii, 325); as far as it was so, Συριστής would be a more correct Greek term for the Jew of Semitic speech (see: Ἑβραΐς, and cf. Dalman, _Words_, 7): [[Act.6.1|Act.6:1]], [[2Co.11.22|2Co.11:22]], [[Php.3.5|Php.3:5]].
† (AS)

G1402.def:
**δουλόω**, -ῶ
(δοῦλος), [in LXX for עָבַד ;]
**to enslave, bring into bondage**: [[Act.7.6|Act.7:6]] (LXX), [[2Pe.2.19|2Pe.2:19]] metaphorically, [[1Co.9.19|1Co.9:19]] pass., before ἐν, [[1Co.7.15|1Co.7:15]] τ. θεῷ, [[Rom.6.22|Rom.6:22]] τ. δικαιοσύνῃ, [[Rom.6.18|Rom.6:18]] οἴνῳ, [[Tit.2.3|Tit.2:3]] ὑπὸ τὰ στοιχεῖα τ. κόσμου, [[Gal.4.3|Gal.4:3]] (Cremer, 217).†
(AS)

G1497.def:
**εἴδωλον**, -ου, τό
(εἶδος), [in LXX for אֱלוֹהָּ, גְּלוּלִים, etc. ;]
1. in cl.
(a) **a phantom, image, likeness**;
(b) **an image in the mind, an idea, fancy**.
2. In LXX and NT,
(a) **an image of a god, an idol** (cf. Polyb., xxxi, 3, 13): [[Act.7.41|Act.7:41]], [[1Co.12.2|1Co.12:2]], [[Rev.9.20|Rev.9:20]];
(b) **the false god** or **idol worshipped in an image** (_ICC_, on I Th, l.with): [[Act.15.20|Act.15:20]], [[Rom.2.22|Rom.2:22]], [[1Co.8.4, 7; 10.19|1Co.8:4, 7 10:19]] [[2Co.6.18|2Co.6:18]], [[1Th.1.9|1Th.1:9]], [[1Jn.5.21|1Jn.5:21]].†
(AS)

G1408.def:
**δρόμος**, -ου, ὁ
(δραμεῖν, see: τρέχω) [in LXX chiefly for מְרוּצָה ;]
**a course**: figuratively, of life or ministry, [[Act.13.25; 20.24|Act.13:25 20:24]], [[2Ti.4.7|2Ti.4:7]].†
(AS)

G1458.def:
**ἐγκαλέω**, -ῶ,
[in LXX for אמר, etc.; with dative, [[Zec.1.4|Zec.1:4]] (קָרָא אֶל), [[Wis.12.12|Wis.12:12]], [[Sir.46.19|Sir.46:19]] ;]
1. **to call in, demand**.
2. **to bring a charge against, accuse**: with dative of person(s) (as in cl.), [[Act.19.38; 23.28|Act.19:38 23:28]]; before κατά, with genitive of person(s), [[Rom.8.33|Rom.8:33]] Pass., **to be accused**: with genitive of thing(s); στάσεως, [[Act.19.40|Act.19:40]] ὦν (perh. by attraction = ἅ), [[Act.26.2|Act.26:2]] before περί, with genitive of thing(s), [[Act.23.29; 26.7|Act.23:29 26:7]] (Cremer, 743).
† SYN.: αἰτιάομαι (which see), διαβάλλω, ἐπικαλέω, κατηγορέω.
(AS)

G1446.def:
**Ἑβραΐς** (WH, Ἐβ-), -ίδος (Aram. עִבְרַי), peculiar form of Ἑβραϊκός,
[in LXX, ἡ Ἑ. φωνή, [[4Ma.12.7; 16.15|4Ma.12:7 16:15]] * ;]
in NT, ἡ Ἑ. διάλεκτος, **Hebrew**, i.e. the Aramaic vernacular of Palestine: [[Act.21.40; 22.2; 26.14|Act.21:40 22:2 26:14]].†
(AS)

G1475.def:
**ἔδαφος**, -εος (-ους), τό,
[in LXX for עָפָר, קַרְקע, etc. ;]
**bottom, pavement, ground**: [[Act.22.7|Act.22:7]]†
(AS)

G1465.def:
**ἐγκόπτω**, see: ἐνκ-.
**ἐν-κόπτω** (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν; and in I Pe, l.with, ἐκκ-);
1. to cut into (as in breaking up a road), hence, 2. to hinder: with accusative [[Act.24.4|Act.24:4]], [[1Th.2.18|1Th.2:18]], . inf., [[Gal.5.7|Gal.5:7]] before τοῦ, with inf., [[Rom.15.22|Rom.15:22]] εἰς τό, with inf, [[1Pe.3.7|1Pe.3:7]]†
(AS)

G1409.def:
**Δρούσιλλα** (Rec. Δρουσίλλα), ης, ἡ
**Drusilla**, wife of Felix: [[Act.24.24|Act.24:24]]†
(AS)

G1466.def:
**ἐγκράτεια**, -ας, ἡ (-ἐγκρατής),
[in LXX: [[Sir.18.15, 30|Sir.18:15, 30]] [[4Ma.5.34|4Ma.5:34]] * ;]
1. prop., **mastery, control**.
2. (sc. ἑαθτοῦ) **self-control**: [[Act.24.25|Act.24:25]], [[Gal.5.23|Gal.5:23]], [[2Pe.1.6|2Pe.1:6]] (see _DB_, iv, 558b 695a; Page on Ac, l.with).
† (AS)

G1429.def:
**δωδεκά-φυλος**, -ον
(δώδεκα, φυλή),
**of twelve tribes**: as subst. neut., τό δ. (cf. λαὸς ὁ δ., Sibyll. Orac.), **the twelve tribes**, [[Act.26.7|Act.26:7]]†
(AS)

G1434.def:
**δώρημα**, -τος, τό
(δωρέω), [in LXX: [[Sir.31.18|Sir.31:18]] ([[Sir.34.18|Sir.34:18]])* ;]
**a gift, boon**: [[Rom.5.16|Rom.5:16]], [[Jas.1.17|Jas.1:17]].†
_SYN._: see: δόμα (AS)

G1461.def:
**ἐγκεντρίζω**, see: ἐνκ-.
**ἐν-κεντρίζω** (Rec. ἐγρ-, see: ἐν; κεντρίζω, to graft),
[in LXX: [[Wis.16.11|Wis.16:11]] *;]
to ingraft, graft in. figuratively, with accusative of person(s), [[Rom.11.17,19,23,24|Rom.11:17,19,23,24]].†
(AS)

G1452.def:
**ἐγγύτερος**, see: ἐγγύς.
**ἐγγύς**, _adv._,
[in LXX chiefly for קָרוֹב ;]
**near**;
1. **of place**: [[Jhn.19.20, 42|Jhn.19:20, 42]]; as prep. with genitive (M, _Pr._, 99), [[Luk.19.11|Luk.19:11]], [[Jhn.3.23; 6.19, 23; 11.18, 54|Jhn.3:23 6:19, 23 11:18, 54]], [[Act.1.12|Act.1:12]]; with dative, [[Act.9.38; 27.8|Act.9:38 27:8]]; superl., ἔγγιστα, [[Mrk.6.36|Mrk.6:36]], WH, mg.; metaphorically, ֹοἱ ἐ., opposite to οἱ μακράν, [[Eph.2.17|Eph.2:17]] ἐ. γίνεσθαι, [[Eph.2.13|Eph.2:13]] ἐ. σου τὸ ῥῆμα, [[Rom.10.8|Rom.10:8]] (LXX).
2. **Of time**: [[Mat.24.32; 26.18|Mat.24:32 26:18]], [[Mrk.13.28, 29|Mrk.13:28, 29]] [[Luk.21.30, 31|Luk.21:30, 31]] [[Jhn.2.13; 6.4; 7.2; 11.55|Jhn.2:13 6:4 7:2 11:55]], [[Rev.1.3; 22.10|Rev.1:3 22:10]]; ὁ κύριος ἐ., [[Php.4.5|Php.4:5]] before ἐπὶ θύραις, [[Mat.24.33|Mat.24:33]] compar., ἐγγύτερον (neut. of adj. -ος, used adverbially), [[Rom.13.11|Rom.13:11]] (cf. R, txt.); as prep. with genitive, ἐ. κατάρας, [[Heb.6.8|Heb.6:8]] ἀφανισμοῦ, [[Heb.8.13|Heb.8:13]] (cf. Cremer, 223).
† (AS)

G1414.def:
**δυνατέω**, -ῶ
(δυνατός),
**to be able, be powerful, mighty**: with inf., [[Rom.14.4|Rom.14:4]], [[2Co.9.8|2Co.9:8]]; absol., opposite to ἀσθενῶ [[2Co.13.3|2Co.13:3]]†
(AS)

G1405.def:
**δράσσομαι **
[in LXX for נָשַׁק pi., [[Psa.2.12|Psa.2:12]] elsewhere קָמַץ, as [[Lev.2.2|Lev.2:2]] ;]
**to grasp with the hand, to lay hold of**: metaphorically, with accusative (M, _Pr._, 65), [[1Co.3.19|1Co.3:19]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G1467.def:
**ἐγκρατεύομαι**, depon.,
[in LXX for אפק, [[Gen.43.31|Gen.43:31]], [[1Sa.13.12|1Ki.13:12]], [[Est.5.10|Est.5:10]] א 3 * ;]
**to exercise self-control:** [[1Co.7.9|1Co.7:9]] with accusative, πάντα (see Bl., 91), [[1Co.9.25|1Co.9:25]]†
(AS)

G1476.def:
**ἑδραῖος**, -ον (ἕδρα, _a seat_), [in Sm.: [[Psa.33.14|Ps 32 (33):14]], al. ;]
1. **sitting, seated**.
2. **steadfast, firm**; metaphorically, of moral fixity: [[1Co.7.37; 15.58|1Co.7:37 15:58]], [[Col.1.23|Col.1:23]].
† (AS)

G1493.def:
**εἰδώλον** (Rec. -εῖον), -ου, τό
(εἴδωλον), [in LXX: Dan LXX 1:2 (בֵּית אוֹצַר אֱלֹהִים), Bel 9, I [[Est.2.10|Est.2:10]], [[1Ma.1.47; 10.83|1Ma.1:47 10:83]] * ;]
**an idol's temple**: [[1Co.8.10|1Co.8:10]] (cf. Ἀσταρτεῖον, [[1Sa.31.10|1Ki.31:10]] see _ICC_, in I Co, l.with).†
(AS)

G1464.def:
**ἐγκοπή**, see: ἐνκ-.
**ἐν-κοπή** (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν; T, ἐκκ-), -ῆς, ἡ (ἐγκόπτω) ;
1. an incision, a cutting, break. 2. Metaphorical, **an interruption, a hindrance**: [[1Co.9.12|1Co.9:12]]†
(AS)

G1426.def:
**δυσφημία**, -ας, ἡ
(δύσφημος, slanderous), [in LXX: [[1Ma.7.38|1Ma.7:38]], [[3Ma.2.20|3Ma.2:20]] * ;]
**evil-speaking, defamation**: opposite to εὐφημία, [[2Co.6.8|2Co.6:8]]†
(AS)

G1469.def:
**ἐγ-κρίνω**, see: ἐνκ-.
**ἐν-κρίνω** (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν),
**to reckon among **: ἑαυτούς, [[2Co.10.12|2Co.10:12]]†
(AS)

G1481.def:
**ἐθνάρχης**, -ου, ὁ
(ἔθνος, ἄρχω), [in LXX: [[1Ma.14.47; 15.1, 2|1Ma.14:47 15:1, 2]] * ;]
**an ethnarch, a provincial governor** (cf. I Mac, ll. with; FlJ, _Ant._, xiii, 6, 6; Dalman, 332): [[2Co.11.32|2Co.11:32]]†
(AS)

G1412.def:
**δυναμόω**, -ῶ
(δύναμις), [in LXX for עָזַז, [[Psa.52.7; 68.28|Psa.52:7 68:28]]; גָּבַר pi., hi., [[Ecc.10.10|Ecc.10:10]], [[Dan.9.27|Da TH 9:27]] * ;]
**to make strong, strengthen**: [[Eph.6.10|Eph.6:10]] (WH, mg.; ἐνδυν-, WH, txt., RV), [[Col.1.11|Col.1:11]], [[Heb.11.34|Heb.11:34]].†
(AS)

G1468.def:
**ἐγκρατής**, -ές
(κράτος), [in LXX: [[Wis.8.20|Wis.8:20]], [[Sir.6.27; 15.1; 26.15; 27.30|Sir.6:27 15:1 26:15 27:30]], al. ;]
1. **strong, powerful**.
2. C. genitive of thing(s), **master of**, hence,
3. (sc. ἑαυτοῦ), **self -controlled, exercising self-control**: [[Tit.1.8|Tit.1:8]]
† _SYN._: σώφρων (see reff. s. ἐγκράτεια). (AS)

G1450.def:
**ἔγγυος**, -ου, ὁ, ἡ,
[in LXX: [[Sir.29.15, 16|Sir.29:15, 16]] [[2Ma.10.28|2Ma.10:28]] * ;]
**a surety**: [[Heb.7.22|Heb.7:22]] (exx. from π., see MM, _Exp._, xi; cf. Cremer, 222).†
(AS)

G1457.def:
**ἐγκαινίζω**, see: ἐνκ-.
**ἐν-καινίζω** (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν),
[in LXX: (to renew) [[1Sa.11.14|1Ki.11:14]], [[2Ch.15.8|2Ch.15:8]], [[Psa.51.10|Ps 50(51):10]] (Br-m pi.); (to dedicate) [[Deu.20.5|Deu.20:5]], [[2Ch.7.5|2Ch.7:5]] (-^jn); [[Isa.16.11; 41.1; 45.16|Isa.16:11 41:1 45:16]] (aliter in Heb.), Si 33(36):6, [[1Ma.4.36,54,57; 5.1|1Ma.4:36,54,57 5:1]], [[2Ma.2.29|2Ma.2:29]] *;]
1. to innovate (Eust.). 2. to renew (LXX ut supr.). 3. to initiate, inaugurate, dedicate (LXX ut supr.) : διαθήκην, [[Heb.9.18|Heb.9:18]] ; ὁδόν, [[Heb.10.20|ib. 10:20]] (Cremer, 323).†
(AS)

G1463.def:
**ἐγκομβόομαι**, -οῦμαι
(κόμβος, a knot, whence ἐγκόμβωμα, a garment tied on over others, used especially of a frock or apron worn by slaves),
**to put on oneself**, as a garment, **gird on**: ἀλλήλοις τ. ταπεινοφροσύνην (as for service, RV, cf. Thayer, see word, but cf. also _ICC_, in l.), [[1Pe.5.5|1Pe.5:5]]†
(AS)

G1460.def:
**ἐγκατοικέω**, see: ἐνκ-.
**ἐν-κατοικέω**, -ῶ (Rec. ἐγκ-, see: ἐν),
**to dwell among**: before ἐν, [[2Pe.2.8|2Pe.2:8]]†
(AS)

G1472.def:
**ἐγχρίω**,
[in LXX: [[Jer.4.30|Jer.4:30]] (קרע). [[Tob.2.10; 6.8; 11.7|Tob.2:10 6:8 11:7]] * ;]
**to rub in, anoint**: mid., with dupl. accusative, [[Rev.3.18|Rev.3:18]]†
(AS)

G1404.def:
